name: SOC AI Auto-Response - AWS Alert -> VT -> LLM -> Isolate -> Discord/Slack

nodes.name: 5. LLM - Incident Analysis
nodes.notes: Swap for Anthropic/Ollama if preferred: change URL + model. Keep a FAST small model for the <5s budget. Full prompt in ../prompts/llm-incident-analysis.md

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "gpt-4o-mini", "temperature": 0.1, "response_format": { "type": "json_object" }, "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "You are a SOC analyst. Respond ONLY with valid JSON: {summary, severity: low|medium|high|critical, confidence: 0-100, is_true_positive: bool, recommended_action: monitor|block_ip|isolate_instance|escalate_human, mitre_technique, next_steps: []}. FIM on /etc/shadow|passwd|sudoers = critical + isolate. SSH brute force + VT malicious>=5 = high/critical. Single failed login + VT clean = low, never isolate. Never recommend terminate." }, { "role": "user", "content": "Alert: " + JSON.stringify($json.alert) + " VirusTotal: " + JSON.stringify($json.virustotal) } ] }

nodes.name: 8a. AWS Lambda - Isolate Instance
nodes.notes: Requires n8n AWS credentials scoped ONLY to lambda:InvokeFunction on the isolation Lambda. See lambda/isolate_instance.py

nodes.name: 8b. Notify - Discord/Slack
nodes.notes: For Slack: replace Discord embed JSON with Slack blocks {text: ...} and use SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL. Same node, same payload structure works for a first version.

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "content": "🚨 **SOC AUTO-RESPONSE**", "embeds": [{ "title": "[" + $json.analysis.severity.toUpperCase() + "] " + $json.alert.alert_type, "description": $json.analysis.summary, "color": $json.analysis.severity === 'critical' ? 15158332 : 15105570, "fields": [ {"name":"Source IP","value": String($json.alert.source_ip || 'n/a') + " (VT malicious: " + $json.virustotal.malicious + ")", "inline": true}, {"name":"Instance","value": $json.alert.instance_id || $json.alert.host, "inline": true}, {"name":"Action","value": $json.should_isolate ? '✅ INSTANCE ISOLATED (Quarantine SG)' : $json.analysis.recommended_action, "inline": true}, {"name":"Confidence","value": String($json.analysis.confidence) + '%', "inline": true} ] }] }
